description: Explicit non-file test representations for frozen edge cases whose invariant is about lifecycle, absence, reconciliation, persistence, or later-milestone policy rather than one standalone core JSON entity.

cases.title: Cross-source similarity does not imply Activity identity
cases.assertion: Two source records with similar time/distance/geometry remain distinct Activities unless an explicit auditable reconciliation establishes equivalence.
cases.future_test_shape: Feed two adapter records with deliberately similar metadata and assert that no automatic core merge occurs; then test an explicit reconciliation path separately.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The frozen Activity schema intentionally contains no approximate matching fields or reconciliation object.

cases.title: Repeated ingestion preserves real-world Activity identity
cases.assertion: Re-ingesting the same source evidence must not create a duplicate real-world Activity fact.
cases.future_test_shape: Ingest identical source content twice under the same and different display names; assert persisted Activity/TrackSource idempotency according to content/provenance policy.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: Idempotency is behavior across persistence operations, not a property of one serialized entity.

cases.title: One Activity may own multiple TrackSources
cases.assertion: A single established Activity identity may be referenced by multiple independent TrackSources such as FIT and GPX without source multiplicity creating Activity multiplicity.
cases.future_test_shape: Build one Activity plus two TrackSources with distinct representation/provenance, normalize both independently, and assert both retain the same Activity owner.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The invariant is graph cardinality across multiple aggregate instances.

cases.title: Corrupted durable source remains evidence while parse fails
cases.assertion: A durable TrackSource remains valid evidence when parsing fails; no CanonicalTrack or outside classification is synthesized from that failure.
cases.future_test_shape: Run a corrupted source through the parser and assert explicit parse failure, preserved TrackSource provenance, zero produced CanonicalTrack revisions, and zero SpatialAssessment results.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The existing corrupted TrackSource fixture proves source representability; parse failure/outcome is execution behavior.

cases.title: No usable GPS produces no assessable track or assessment
cases.assertion: A source with workout metadata but no usable positions does not produce an assessable CanonicalTrack and never synthesizes outside.
cases.future_test_shape: Parse a no-position source fixture; assert no usable CanonicalTrack/SpatialAssessment and explicit unresolved workflow outcome.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The invariant depends on absence of derived objects after parsing rather than validity of one entity JSON file.

cases.title: Quality cleaning never erases normalized observations
cases.assertion: Outlier detection/cleaning may derive usable geometry or quality annotations, but normalized observation evidence and algorithm/version provenance remain auditable.
cases.future_test_shape: Run an extreme-jump track through quality validation and assert raw normalized observations are unchanged while any cleaned result is separately provenance-tagged.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The exact quality-derived representation and anomaly thresholds are intentionally implementation-layer decisions.

cases.title: One CanonicalTrack can be assessed independently against multiple TargetAreas
cases.assertion: Two Track × TargetArea-revision pairs yield independent SpatialAssessments without storing relation on CanonicalTrack.
cases.future_test_shape: Reuse one CanonicalTrack revision with two TargetArea revisions and assert two independent assessment identities/results while the track JSON is byte-identical.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The invariant compares a graph containing multiple assessments rather than one standalone entity.

cases.title: TargetArea revision does not mutate source or canonical evidence
cases.assertion: Changing a TargetArea boundary creates a new TargetArea revision and new derived assessment while historical area/assessment revisions and CanonicalTrack remain unchanged.
cases.future_test_shape: Assess one CanonicalTrack against TargetArea r1 and r2; assert both historical assessments remain addressable and track/source hashes remain unchanged.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: Version-change immutability is a multi-revision lifecycle assertion.

cases.title: ManualDecision never overwrites algorithmic SpatialAssessment
cases.assertion: A human task-facing override is appended as an auditable ManualDecision referencing an exact SpatialAssessment revision; the algorithmic relation/completeness/segments remain immutable.
cases.future_test_shape: Persist partial assessment, append manual outside decision, derive effective task-facing outside result, supersede/revoke decision, and assert the original assessment and prior decision remain unchanged.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: ManualDecision is an audit/runtime extension outside the six v0.1 spatial-core schemas.

cases.title: Duplicate raw-file import is idempotent
cases.assertion: Repeated import of identical durable content must not create duplicate evidence facts.
cases.future_test_shape: Import identical bytes twice using different filenames and assert content identity/deduplication and stable provenance behavior.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The case is explicitly deferred to persistent content hashing and idempotency.

cases.title: Remote locator is not durable acquisition
cases.execution_milestone: Milestone 5 — Source Adapter Layer with Milestone 3 durability
cases.assertion: Receiving a URL/temporary locator is not acquisition success until source bytes/evidence are durably persisted and reopenable.
cases.future_test_shape: Return a valid remote locator but fail persistence/reopen; assert no durable-available TrackSource state is recorded.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: TrackSource core schema represents preserved evidence, while acquisition state belongs to adapter/runtime lifecycle.

cases.title: Parser-version changes remain traceable to one immutable TrackSource
cases.assertion: Different parser/normalizer versions may produce different CanonicalTrack revisions from the same TrackSource revision, and each output records exact normalizer provenance.
cases.future_test_shape: Normalize the same source using parser v1 and v2; assert distinct CanonicalTrack revision IDs, identical TrackSource revision reference, and distinct normalizer.version provenance.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: The schema already carries provenance; the edge case requires comparative execution across parser versions.

cases.title: Task completion can precede remote-source exhaustion
cases.assertion: Stopping criteria are task/runtime policy and must not alter Activity, TrackSource, or CanonicalTrack identity.
cases.future_test_shape: Given an objective already satisfied by acquired evidence and remaining low-value remote candidates, assert acquisition stops while core persisted entities remain unchanged.
cases.reason_not_entity_fixture: Objective-aware stopping is explicitly deferred resource policy.
